dashboard.label: Training Lens
dashboard.description: Recorded volume, consistency and activity history. Reported mode preserves source anomalies; Validated excludes affected distance/duration comparisons. Year grain uses snapshot history; Comparable YTD ends at the import calendar date. Empty charts mean no eligible data in the selection. Automatic selects the first available metric; invalid bookmarked IDs show an explicit unavailable state. Availability is snapshot-wide and refreshes every five minutes.
